title: DealsOfferExpiredPayload
description: deals.offer.expired v1 (OpenVibe.Deals server/domain/indexing.js emitOffer, called from server/domain/offers.js expireRow). An active offer became expired: its submitter or a moderator marked it expired (POST /offers/:id/expire; reason submitter, moderator or "moderator: <note>"), or the worker found that its STATED end time has passed (expireDue; reason stated_expiry). Expiry is never inferred from missing data. Written in the transaction that set the status and the moderation_log row, next to deals.index_document.upserted (the page stays in Search as a noindex document with reason expired). The rest of the payload is the offer as it now stands, as in deals.offer.created. Envelope: subject { type: offer, id: <offer_id> }, visibility internal (an expired offer is never public), priority important (default), actor user:<usr_…> who marked it, service:<calling service> when a service acts without a person, service:deals for the worker. No consumer is built yet.

slug.description: Page slug: the slugified title plus the last six characters of the id.

url.description: Canonical offer page URL on Deals (/d/<slug>).

store.description: Store domain: the offer link's host without a leading www.; null when none could be derived.

product_id.description: Deals product the offer is attached to, if any.

latest_observation.description: The newest observation across the offer's merge group; null only when the group has none.

price.description: Decimal text as stated; null when no price was stated (never 0).

freshness.description: fresh while the latest observation is younger than DEALS_FRESHNESS_HOURS, stale after, unobserved without one.

indexability.description: The SEO gate decision in Search's shape (index-hooks searchIndexability).

reasons.description: Search reason names, e.g. stale_price, expired, takedown, owner_decision (imported or AI text awaiting review).

reason.description: submitter, stated_expiry, moderator, or "moderator: <note>" (the note as the moderator wrote it, whitespace collapsed).
